svg.title: How much governance an asset gets
svg.desc: Risk class, process impact and process criticality give the change materiality, which sets the path. On every path the level of autonomy sets minimum controls, personal data starts the data protection route, and a high-risk system carries its own requirements.
svg.text: How much governance an asset gets
The change materiality decides the path. The level of autonomy, personal data and a high-risk class add what every path must carry.
THE PATH · for full-track assets: agents, AI-enabled systems, platforms · rated at Gate 1 and on every substantial change
